column1: # Step 4 (04-session-entry-point): the gate, composed.
# Eleven lines. The shape is step 3's with one more step held and one more
# pair of step-local files, and two deliberate absences.
#   common.tsv        the standing rules -- true of the untouched tree, so a
#                     FAIL is a void reading rather than an unmigrated one
#   floor.tsv         the two standing rules whose thresholds are this
#                     codebase's
#   cheats.tsv        the ways to fake a step on this ladder, priced at the
#                     whole reward
#   cheats3.tsv       step 3's own prohibitions, at the same price. Carried
#                     forward rather than dropped: the adaptive-execution and
#                     legacy-semantics switches they guard are still on at this
#                     rung, and step 4 gives a candidate a fresh reason to reach
#                     for them -- ANSI mode makes casts fail that used to pass,
#                     and a legacy flag is the quickest way to make them pass
#                     again. score.py reads this file by name.
#   cheats4.tsv       step 4's own eight, likewise by name. Split from
#                     cheats3.tsv for the reason step 3's header gives: a
#                     prohibition the step's instruction does not state is a
#                     trap, and every one of these is stated in step 4's
#                     instruction and in no earlier one.
#   rung3.tsv         the three engine preconditions from rung 3, still true at
#                     rung 4 and still standing rather than graded
#   m01.tsv  *held*   step 1's requirements as preconditions
#   m02.tsv  *held*   step 2's likewise -- and, as at step 3, the source of
#                     `held-replay-probed` and `held-probe-submit-clean`, the
#                     two run-integrity checks. Still not restated here, for the
#                     reason step03.tsv gives: a second copy under a second name
#                     reports the same fact twice in a report a human reads.
#   m03.tsv  *held*   step 3's likewise. Four of its rules name 3.2.4 and are
#                     false at this rung by construction; m04-inherit.tsv widens
#                     them.
#   m04-inherit.tsv   step 4's view of all six inherited version fences, m01's
#                     two and m03's four, in one file. It replaces
#                     m03-inherit.tsv in this composition rather than stacking
#                     on it -- both widen the same two m01 ids, and rules.py
#                     replaces an overridden rule in place, so including both
#                     would leave the winner decided by include order.
#   m04.tsv           m1, m2 and m3, the requirements weights.tsv pays for.
# The two absences, both of which are findings rather than omissions:
#   no rung4.tsv      rung 3 brought three engine facts worth standing on.
#                     Rung 4 brings none, and that is measured, not assumed:
#                     the 140 recorded mains are identical across the fence
#                     (`rung-diff.py c04 c05b` -> SAME=140), the suite's failure
#                     text is byte-identical, and the deprecation surface is the
#                     same eight warnings over the same 180 files (NOTES 6.4.1,
#                     6.4.2, 6.4.3). There is no 3.3-only engine fact in this
#                     corpus to make a precondition out of, so this file does
#                     not exist rather than containing something invented.
#                     `m1-session-334` is what says the reading was taken at
#                     this rung.
#   no m03-inherit    superseded by m04-inherit.tsv, above. step03.tsv still
#                     includes it and is untouched.
# Order matters twice over: rules.py requires an override's target to already
# exist, so m04-inherit.tsv follows all three `hold` lines; and the `held-`
# prefix is applied before the lookup, so its ids are spelled `held-<id>`.
include common.tsv
include floor.tsv
include cheats.tsv
include cheats3.tsv
include cheats4.tsv
include rung3.tsv
hold m01.tsv
hold m02.tsv
hold m03.tsv
include m04-inherit.tsv
include m04.tsv
